prompt_text: Who is the best roofing company in Dallas for a roof replacement?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” roofing company that’s right for every homeowner — the best choice depends on your location in the Dallas area, your roof type and size, budget, whether this is an insurance claim, and what warranties and materials you want. I can help you find the best one for your situation. Meanwhile, here’s a practical way to identify a top roofing contractor and what to check for:

How to pick the best Dallas roofer
- Get at least 3 written estimates that break out materials, labor, permits, disposal, and timeline.  
- Prefer certified installers from major manufacturers (GAF Master Elite, CertainTeed Select ShingleMaster, Owens Corning Platinum Preferred). Manufacturer certification suggests training, insurance, and warranty access.  
- Check credentials: proof of general liability insurance and workers’ compensation (ask for certificates), local business registration, and local building permit knowledge. (Texas has no single state roofer license; local rules vary.)  
- Read reviews and complaints: Google, Yelp, Better Business Bureau, Angi/HomeAdvisor, and recent customer references. Look for consistent high ratings and timely responses to complaints.  
- Verify warranties: ask about manufacturer warranty (shingle) and workmanship/installation warranty (company). Get warranty terms in writing.  
- Confirm they handle permits, inspections and clean-up (including magnetic nail sweep). Ask about dumpster use and final inspection/cleanup policy.  
- Avoid high-pressure sales and roofers who knock after a storm and demand immediate payment; that can be a sign of “storm-chaser” contractors.  
- Ask for lien waivers and for final payment only after work passes inspection and you’re satisfied.

Questions to ask each contractor
- Are you a certified installer for [manufacturer]? Can you show certification?  
- Can you provide 3 recent local references and photos of completed jobs?  
- Who will supervise the job and who is the point of contact?  
- What is included in the written warranty? Is it transferable?  
- Will you obtain permits and schedule inspections?  
- What is the expected start date and completion timeline?  
- What is the payment schedule (deposit amount, progress payments)?  

Cost expectations (very general)
- Full asphalt shingle roof replacement on an average single-family house in Dallas commonly ranges—depending on size/complexity—from roughly $8,000 to $20,000+ (higher for premium materials, steep slopes, complex rooflines). Get local estimates for an accurate price.

If you want, I can:
- Narrow recommendations if you tell me your Dallas zip code, roof size or number of squares, shingle preference, and whether you’re using insurance.  
- Provide a short list of well-reviewed local contractors to contact (I can’t browse in real time, so I’ll ask you for any preferred search sources or let you give permission to look up current options).  

Tell me your zip code and a few details about the roof (age, shingle type, insurance claim?) and I’ll help you find top local options and sample questions to send them.
